text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I arrived at the gymnasium to prepare 
for simulator training—

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: Well, Trainer <username>.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you're the Trainer who was in the 
break room earlier! Um... hello!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The one greeting us so energetically is 
Trainer Kashimoto's trainee, Bitter Glacé.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She showed her true strength right from 
her debut race, quickly drawing attention 
as a rising star.
choice_data_list: Are you heading to training now?

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Yes, based on the debut race results, we 
are about to begin our full-scale training 
regimen.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
I wonder what kind of training it is... I 
hope it's a tough one.
choice_data_list: You want it to be tough?

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, you can't get stronger without 
tough training.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Because Bitter Glace's goal is victory on 
the grandest stage.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
Not just any victory, but a victory forged 
in fierce battle...!

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
No matter how tough the rivals, even 
against upperclassmen, winning on a 
thrilling, grand stage—that is my dream.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Bitter Glace's resolve wasn't just talk; 
she proved it with proper results, too.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
"Because of all that, I decided to ask 
Byerley Turk to help with our training."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What could it mean to ask Byerley Turk for 
help in order to pursue ultimate strength?

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: Yes, I don't particularly mind.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOOOH~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Bitter Glace cheerfully tackled the 
grueling training menu.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
Haa...! Haa...! So tough~! But it feels 
amazing!

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
"It seems to be having quite an effect on 
you. However, I judged that this much 
would be suitable for you."

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
As expected of Trainer Kashimoto! Alright, 
off to the next menu!

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
"To think that after keeping up with such 
an intense routine, your core still 
doesn't waver, and you've maintained the 
power in your strides."

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Her physical capabilities are exceptional, 
even among the debut-class Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
"Never giving up"... that phrase fits her 
to a tee.

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
You can tell she's tough just from her 
build.

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, it should allow for even more 
options regarding the menu.

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
It would also be wise to purposely perform 
the current regimen on dirt or deep turf 
to build a tougher body.

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
Many overseas Umamusume fall into this 
category. If we're setting our sights on 
overseas races, it's not an option we can 
rule out.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
"...I see. So even without adding to the 
regimen, we can push our training even 
further."

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
What do you think? This is the reason I 
asked for Byerley Turk-san's cooperation.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, as you can see, Bitter Glace is very 
eager when it comes to training herself.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
And Byerley Turk-san also strives for an 
ideal strong Umamusume under the 
philosophy of "discipline."

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
When it comes to Bitter Glace's training, 
she provides insights and knowledge from 
perspectives I lack.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Byerley Turk-san, let's incorporate that 
training. However, we should keep it out 
of menus that require speed.

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
So first, we emphasize foundational body 
building. That shouldn't be a problem. 
Next—

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
Trainer Kashimoto, thank you for your hard 
work!

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: Good work. How was today's training?

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
It's the best! The feeling of pushing my 
body just enough, yet distributing the 
fatigue so well!

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
...Heheh, I bet just today alone made me a 
whole lot stronger.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having finished what was visibly grueling 
training, she showed joy rather than 
fatigue.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
Even more so ever since Trainer Kashimoto 
took charge of me!

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
Having a Trainer meant getting stronger, 
but I used to think it also meant being 
somewhat tied down—

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer Kashimoto actually supports what 
I want to do and pushes me forward. She 
supports me so I can get even stronger!"

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
From the training menu to managing my 
condition, you look after so many things 
for me, which makes everything feel so 
fulfilling!

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thanks to you meeting my 
expectations so thoroughly, I'm finding 
this very fulfilling as well.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
"If we continue this relationship, the 
passionate battles you seek will surely 
become reality."

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
"So, I went ahead and drafted your 
upcoming racing rotation right away."

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: Whoa!? You've decided on my next race?!

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Making a mark in the Classic races really 
does bring great prestige to an Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
So, let's first set our sights on a spring 
race to serve as our stepping stone.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: "A Classic race...! Heheh! I get it!"

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
Um, I'm gonna go run one last lap! I was 
finally feeling a nice, pleasant fatigue, 
but now it's totally blown away!

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
"...It cannot be helped. Make sure you 
grow strong."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Bitter Glace, wishing to become stronger, 
and Trainer Kashimoto supporting her. And 
Byerley Turk imparting wisdom to the two 
of them."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I could feel that all three of them had 
their eyes firmly fixed on their goals.
